entries.music_theory_en: male lead vocals (a male voice carrying the melodic line of the song)
entries.plain_ko: 남자 목소리가 노래를 부르는 소리
entries.plain_en: a man's voice singing the song

entries.music_theory_en: vocals (sung human voice as a musical part, gender/register unspecified)
entries.plain_ko: 사람이 노래하는 목소리가 들어간 소리
entries.plain_en: human singing voice in the track

entries.music_theory_en: female lead vocals (a female voice carrying the melodic line of the song)
entries.plain_ko: 여자 목소리가 노래를 부르는 소리
entries.plain_en: a woman's voice singing the song

entries.music_theory_en: voice (the human vocal instrument; may refer to sung or spoken presence in the mix)
entries.plain_ko: 사람 목소리 소리 그 자체, 노래일 수도 말일 수도 있음
entries.plain_en: a human voice, sung or spoken

entries.music_theory_en: male baritone vocals (male voice in the baritone range, between tenor and bass, roughly A2–A4)
entries.plain_ko: 너무 높지도 낮지도 않은, 묵직하고 중저음인 남자 목소리의 노래
entries.plain_en: a deep, mid-low male singing voice

entries.music_theory_en: falsetto (a light head-voice register above the natural chest range, typically breathy and flute-like)
entries.plain_ko: 가수가 일부러 얇고 높게 내는 가성 목소리
entries.plain_en: a light, airy high voice above the singer's normal range

entries.music_theory_en: male tenor vocals (male voice in the tenor range, the higher male register, roughly C3–C5)
entries.plain_ko: 남자 목소리 중에서도 높고 시원하게 뻗는 음역의 노래
entries.plain_en: a high, bright male singing voice

entries.music_theory_en: rap delivery (rhythmic spoken-word vocal performance emphasizing flow and cadence over sung pitch)
entries.plain_ko: 멜로디 없이 리듬을 타며 말하듯 내뱉는 랩 창법
entries.plain_en: rhythmic spoken rapping instead of singing

entries.music_theory_en: vocalist (the singer performing the vocal part)
entries.plain_ko: 노래를 부르는 사람, 즉 가수의 목소리
entries.plain_en: the singer performing the song

entries.music_theory_en: singing (melodic sung vocal performance, as opposed to spoken or rapped delivery)
entries.plain_ko: 말이 아니라 멜로디를 붙여 노래하는 목소리
entries.plain_en: melodic singing with the voice

entries.music_theory_en: male vocalist (a male singer performing the vocal part)
entries.plain_ko: 노래를 부르는 남자 가수의 목소리
entries.plain_en: a male singer performing the song

entries.music_theory_en: vocalizing (wordless vocal sounds such as 'ooh'/'aah' or melodic humming rather than lyrics)
entries.plain_ko: 가사 없이 '우~', '아~' 같은 소리로 멜로디를 내는 목소리
entries.plain_en: wordless 'ooh' and 'aah' vocal sounds

entries.music_theory_en: male rapper (a male vocalist performing rap: rhythmic spoken delivery)
entries.plain_ko: 리듬에 맞춰 랩을 하는 남자 목소리
entries.plain_en: a man rapping over the beat

entries.music_theory_en: rapper (a vocalist performing rap: rhythmic spoken-word delivery over the beat)
entries.plain_ko: 비트 위에서 말하듯 리듬을 타며 랩하는 목소리
entries.plain_en: someone rapping over the beat

entries.music_theory_en: female vocalist (a female singer performing the vocal part)
entries.plain_ko: 노래를 부르는 여자 가수의 목소리
entries.plain_en: a female singer performing the song

entries.music_theory_en: singer (the person performing the sung vocal line)
entries.plain_ko: 노래를 부르는 사람의 목소리
entries.plain_en: a person singing the song

entries.music_theory_en: female soprano vocals (female voice in the soprano range, the highest common voice type, roughly C4–C6)
entries.plain_ko: 맑고 아주 높게 올라가는 여자 목소리의 노래
entries.plain_en: a very high, clear female singing voice

entries.music_theory_en: vocal harmonies (additional vocal lines sung at consonant intervals above or below the lead melody)
entries.plain_ko: 주 멜로디 위아래로 다른 음을 함께 불러 화음을 쌓는 소리
entries.plain_en: extra voices singing different notes that blend with the main melody

entries.music_theory_en: vocal doubling (recording the same line twice and layering the takes for thickness and width)
entries.plain_ko: 같은 보컬 라인을 겹쳐 녹음해 소리를 두껍게 만드는 기법
entries.plain_en: the same vocal line layered on itself to sound thicker

entries.music_theory_en: ad-libs (improvised vocal interjections and fills placed around the main vocal line, common in R&B/hip-hop)
entries.plain_ko: 노래 사이사이에 즉흥으로 넣는 '예~', '오~' 같은 추임새 목소리
entries.plain_en: improvised vocal shouts and fills between the main lines

entries.music_theory_en: layered vocals (multiple stacked vocal tracks — doubles, harmonies, pads — creating a dense vocal texture)
entries.plain_ko: 여러 목소리 트랙을 겹겹이 쌓아 풍성하게 만든 보컬 소리
entries.plain_en: many vocal tracks stacked together for a rich, full sound

entries.music_theory_en: call and response (an antiphonal structure where one voice or part states a phrase and another answers it)
entries.plain_ko: 한 목소리가 부르면 다른 목소리가 대답하듯 주고받는 형식
entries.plain_en: one voice sings a line and another answers back

entries.music_theory_en: unison (two or more voices or instruments performing the exact same pitch/line together)
entries.plain_ko: 여러 목소리나 악기가 같은 음을 똑같이 함께 내는 소리
entries.plain_en: several voices singing the exact same notes together

entries.music_theory_en: ad-lib (a single improvised vocal interjection or fill outside the written melody)
entries.plain_ko: 정해진 가사 밖에서 즉흥으로 내지르는 짧은 추임새 목소리
entries.plain_en: a short improvised vocal shout or fill

entries.music_theory_en: vocal harmonies (supporting vocal lines sung at intervals such as 3rds or 5ths against the lead melody)
entries.plain_ko: 주 멜로디에 3도·5도 같은 다른 음을 겹쳐 불러 화음을 만드는 소리
entries.plain_en: backing voices singing notes that blend in chords with the melody

entries.music_theory_en: vocal harmony (a harmony vocal part sung against the lead melody at a consonant interval)
entries.plain_ko: 주 멜로디에 다른 음 하나를 겹쳐 불러 화음을 이루는 소리
entries.plain_en: a second voice singing a blending note against the melody

entries.music_theory_en: choir (a large ensemble of singers performing in multiple parts, e.g. SATB)
entries.plain_ko: 여러 사람이 함께 파트를 나눠 부르는 합창단 소리
entries.plain_en: a large group of people singing together in parts

entries.music_theory_en: double-tracking (recording a second near-identical performance of the same vocal line and layering it for width and thickness)
entries.plain_ko: 같은 노래를 두 번 녹음해 겹쳐서 목소리를 넓고 두껍게 만드는 녹음 기법
entries.plain_en: the same vocal recorded twice and layered for a fuller sound

entries.music_theory_en: ad-libs (improvised vocal interjections and fills around the main vocal; alternate spelling of 'ad-libs')
entries.plain_ko: 노래 사이사이에 즉흥으로 넣는 짧은 추임새 목소리들
entries.plain_en: improvised vocal shouts and fills between the main lines

entries.music_theory_en: choral (in the style or texture of a choir; multi-part massed voices)
entries.plain_ko: 합창단처럼 여러 목소리가 웅장하게 어우러지는 느낌의 소리
entries.plain_en: voices blended together like a choir

entries.music_theory_en: call and response (an antiphonal exchange where a lead phrase is answered by another voice or group)
entries.plain_ko: 한쪽이 선창하면 다른 쪽이 이어받아 대답하듯 부르는 형식
entries.plain_en: one voice leads and another answers back and forth

entries.music_theory_en: chord progression (an ordered sequence of chords that underpins the harmony of a passage, e.g. I–V–vi–IV)
entries.plain_ko: 곡의 분위기를 만드는, 코드(화음)가 순서대로 바뀌어 가는 흐름
entries.plain_en: the sequence of chords the song moves through

entries.music_theory_en: cadence (a harmonic formula that closes a phrase, e.g. authentic V–I or half cadence, giving a sense of resolution or pause)
entries.plain_ko: 악구 끝에서 마무리되거나 쉬어 가는 느낌을 주는 화성의 매듭
entries.plain_en: the chord move at the end of a phrase that feels like a landing or a pause

entries.music_theory_en: minor seventh chord (a minor triad with a minor 7th added, e.g. Am7; also the m7 interval — soft, mellow, jazzy color)
entries.plain_ko: 재즈나 알앤비에서 자주 쓰는, 부드럽고 살짝 쓸쓸한 느낌의 화음
entries.plain_en: a soft, mellow jazzy chord with a slightly wistful color
entries.llm_prompt: minor seventh chords, mellow jazzy harmony

entries.music_theory_en: harmonic progression (the functional movement of harmony from chord to chord over time; synonym of chord progression)
entries.plain_ko: 화음이 하나에서 다음으로 자연스럽게 이어져 가는 흐름
entries.plain_en: how the chords flow from one to the next

entries.music_theory_en: modulation (a key change: the music shifts its tonal center to a new key, often for lift or contrast)
entries.plain_ko: 곡 중간에 조(키)가 바뀌어 분위기가 확 올라가거나 달라지는 변화
entries.plain_en: the song shifts to a new key, often lifting the energy

entries.music_theory_en: harmonic movement (the sense of motion created as harmonies change; the pacing and direction of chord changes)
entries.plain_ko: 화음이 바뀌면서 곡이 앞으로 나아가는 듯한 움직임의 느낌
entries.plain_en: the feeling of motion as the chords change under the melody

entries.music_theory_en: diatonic (using only the notes and chords of the prevailing key/scale, with no chromatic alterations)
entries.plain_ko: 그 곡의 조 안에 있는 음만 써서 어긋남 없이 자연스럽게 들리는 화성
entries.plain_en: notes and chords that stay neatly inside the song's key

entries.music_theory_en: key change (a modulation to a new tonal center, commonly a step up in a final chorus for added lift)
entries.plain_ko: 마지막 후렴 등에서 조가 한 단계 올라가며 분위기가 고조되는 변화
entries.plain_en: the song jumps to a higher key, making the ending feel bigger
